The man stays facing the lens and jabs his pointing gloved hand toward the camera on the beat, four short jabs, his head nodding in time, his other hand staying in his pocket. Behind him the flames on the press flicker and smoke drifts slowly across the beams; a few burning notes float down and go dark. His hood and suit stay exactly the same; no one else appears. SFX: crackling fire, soft roar of flames. No voices.
